problem:
The length of one leg of a right triangle increases at the rate of $5\text{ m/s},$ while the length of the second leg is decreasing at the rate of $3\text{ m/s}.$ How fast is the length of the hypotenuse changing when the length of the increasing leg is $9\text{ m}$ and the length of the decreasing leg is $12\text{ m}?$

The length of the hypotenuse is changing at a rate of
{{field-1}} $\text{m}/\text{s}.$
